posts.text: It will be wrapped in names.
Key Nº 0001 goes to whoever's fastest on Nov 9 at noon ET.
Tomorrow, noon ET, you can own a car.

I'm selling unlimited keys to one Lamborghini.

$50 each. No limit.

Everyone who buys one owns it.
posts.note: THE launch post. No link here: it goes in L7 (X suppresses links in the main post).

posts.text:
Here's the deal.

You buy a key. I buy the car. Your key, solid brass and numbered, gets mailed to your door with a certificate that has your name on it.

If we don't sell 6,000 keys by Dec 9, everyone is refunded. Automatically.

"If 6,000 people own it, how much do I own?"

About 238 grams. Roughly a phone.

At 100,000 owners it's 14 grams. A lug nut.

That's the point.

When the presale closes, the car gets wrapped in every owner's name. Bumper to bumper.

The more owners, the smaller the names. At 6,000 they're 18 mm tall.

Every dollar is public.

$20.45 → the car
$13.00 → your key, box, certificate
$8.80 → taxes
$6.00 → shipping it to you
$1.75 → card fees

Receipts go up on the site as they happen.

What it isn't: something you'll make money on. No payout, no resale split, and the key doesn't start the car.

It's an art project about what owning something means when everyone does.
